name: La Terreta Food Labels for WooCommerce
author: laterretagames

sections.description:
Print Product Labels for WooCommerce allows you to generate PDF labels for your WooCommerce products with complete food information.

Features

  • Product labels in PDF format
  • Unlimited ingredients per product
  • All 14 allergens and traces (EC Regulation 1169/2011)
  • Automatic batch number generation
  • Expiration date on labels (configurable days)
  • Company data on labels
  • Available in 4 languages: English, Spanish, French, German
  • Expiration date, border and spacing settings
  • Ingredient and allergen management

Premium Features

Upgrade to Premium to unlock additional features:

  • Net weight on labels
  • Conservation and consumption instructions
  • QR code on labels
  • Professional shipping labels
  • Multiple label copies
  • Ingredients per product variation (variable products)
  • Professional allergen icons
  • Reorder products within an order
  • Food information tab on product pages
  • Priority technical support

View plans and pricing →

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Additional Info

Support

FREE version: Community support through WordPress.org forums

Premium version: Priority technical support included

  • Web: https://www.laterretagames.com/contact-me/
  • Email: soporte@laterretagames.com

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data outside your own WordPress database. All information is stored locally.

Credits

Developed by La Terreta Games
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/imprimir-etiquetas-productos-free directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Print Labels FREE > Company Information to configure your company data
  4. Go to Settings to configure expiration days, borders and spacing
  5. Use the Print Product Labels button on any WooCommerce order

IMPORTANT: This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.
sections.faq:
How do I print labels?

Go to any WooCommerce order in your admin panel. You will see a “Print Product Labels (PDF)” button in the order details section.

How do I add ingredients to a product?

Go to Print Labels FREE > Ingredients/Allergens to create your ingredient list. Then open any product in WooCommerce and assign ingredients in the new tab added to the product data panel.

How do I upgrade to Premium?

Visit: https://www.laterretagames.com/producto/plugin-imprimir-etiquetas/

What happens to my data when upgrading?

All your data is preserved when upgrading from FREE to Premium.

Does it comply with food labeling regulations?

The free version covers ingredients, allergens, batch number and expiration date — the core fields of EC Regulation 1169/2011. The Premium version adds net weight, conservation and consumption instructions for full compliance.
